faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SaaS Boilerplate

items.question: What should I customize first?
items.answer: Start with branding, environment values, subscription plans, and the domain-specific service layer.

items.question: How does SaaS Boilerplate compare to other tools?
items.answer: SaaS Boilerplate combines reusable infrastructure, human-quality content via our Usage dashboard, native CMS publishing, and analytics integration in one platform. Many tools focus on just one aspect, requiring you to piece together multiple solutions.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to set this up?
items.answer: No. If you can install a WordPress plugin, you can use SaaS Boilerplate. Our guided onboarding walks you through everything in under 15 minutes.

items.question: Which providers are included?
items.answer: Supabase, Stripe, Cloudflare, Brevo, Resend, analytics providers, and OAuth provider hooks are included.

items.question: Can I remove modules I do not need?
items.answer: Yes. The boilerplate is organized by feature areas so optional services can be removed or replaced as your product requires.

items.question: What's your refund policy?
items.answer: We offer a money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact our support team within the trial period.
